members.cluster_pick_reason: #2703 is the only PR that adds __reduce__ to both the base class and the subclass, giving complete coverage of the pickle round-trip. #2555 leaves the base McpError broken (subclass only). #2478 uses a module-level helper dispatching function rather than inline __reduce__ methods, which is less idiomatic and requires callers to know about the helper. #2703's approach — reconstructing McpError from self.error (preserving the typed ErrorData payload) and UrlElicitationRequiredError from (self._elicitations, self.message) — is the cleanest and most complete. Note: #2703 targets the v1.x branch (McpError lowercase); the same two-method pattern should be applied to the main-branch MCPError if a main-branch fix is also needed.
